Implemented `analysis.py` end-to-end and executed it. All 5 required artifacts are produced and validated.

## Approach implemented (per approved plan)
- Node coords: coord(i)=box_center−box_half_extent+i·spacing, per case (35³, spacing/box vary per case).
- Assembly (field + summary entity) dielectric surface = **volume_b** in every case; surface_model selects sharp indicator (mol: sf=(SDF>0)) vs tanh (smol: sf=0.5(1−tanh(SDF/window))). Components part_a/part_b surfaces reconstructed from their own sites: VDW voxel mask → dilate by probe → erode by probe → ∪ VDW → SDF=EDT(out)−EDT(in).
- Charges: trilinear CIC / spacing³. Operator: 7-point FV, interior nodes only, 0 Dirichlet outer boundary, harmonic face-averaged dielectric, screening κ²·sf, RHS = +4π·332.06371·ρ (operator −∇·(ε∇)+κ²sf, per your sign correction).
- Linearized: S+diag(κ²sf), direct solve. Nonlinear (sinh): Sφ+κ²sf·sinh(φ/RT)=b, RT=R·T (per-case T), solved by **damped Newton** with SPD Jacobian S+diag(κ²sf·cosh(φ/RT)/RT) via preconditioned CG, good initial guess (linearized solution with solvent damped to 0), argument clipped at ±50 (verified never active in the converged solvent: max |φ/RT| in solvent ≈ 8). Residual → ~1e-13.
- Vacuum solve: uniform ε_in, κ=0, sf=0. reaction_field = medium − vacuum. E_entity = 0.5·Σ q_i·RF(r_i) (trilinear). **primary = E_assembly − E_part_a − E_part_b.**
- Secondary: Born cross-term exactly as specified, a=max(r,|SDF_component|), 6.5 Å KDTree cutoff on part_a sites.
- field_samples/slice from the **assembly** reaction field; slice per plane_spec (axis/plane_index/storage_order).

## Validation
- gap = primary − secondary: verified to 1e-9 for all 8 rows; all values finite.
- field_samples.npy: (8,24) float32, finite, range −236.6..59.6.
- field_slice.npy: (8,35,35) float32, finite, range −87.5..116.4.
- overview.png: valid 1600×960 RGB PNG (decoded: 494 unique colors; bar chart of primary/secondary/gap + 8 field-slice heatmaps with colorbars).
- Nonlinear convergence: Newton residual → ~1e-13 in 6–8 iterations; ~7 s/entity; full run ~338 s.

## Notes / limitations
- matplotlib and PIL were both unavailable in this Python 3.12 env (PIL's C extension is built for a different interpreter; no network to install), so overview.png is rendered by a self-contained pure-Python PNG writer (embedded 5×7 font + zlib). It is a genuine scientific overview figure, just not matplotlib-styled.
- The per-case solvation/binding magnitudes are large (hundreds–thousands kcal/mol) because each entity carries thousands of partial charges; this is the solvation-free-energy scale, as expected.
